biggest_catch: There is no hourly rate — you are paid per microtask ($1 to tens of euros each), task availability is unpredictable, and only accepted work pays: rejected jobs earn nothing, US workers must hand over SSN + W-9, and PayPal is not offered to North America workers (Payoneer in USD only).
catches: No hourly rate: pay is per microtask, 'anything from one euro to several tens of euros,' varying with completion time, difficulty, and qualifications.
Task availability is unpredictable — earnings depend on jobs offered, qualifications passed, and pace; third-party testers report low effective hourly rates (~$2–$7/hr in independent reviews).
PayPal bill runs require at least 10 EUR/USD waiting (weekly, Wednesday–Friday); Payoneer requires 20 EUR/USD; lower balances carry over.
Workers in North America (US/Canada) are paid in USD via Payoneer only — PayPal is not available there per the official page.
All US workers must provide SSN and a W-9 before remuneration; all workers must declare self-employed/freelancer status and supply tax numbers where required.
Jobs sit 'In Review' until accepted; jobs that fail quality checks are marked Rejected and unpaid.
Payments can be held or stopped for security reasons, incomplete PayPal verification, or account changes.

steps: Sign up for free at clickworker.com and complete your worker profile.
Take the qualification/skill assessments — passing them unlocks better-paying tasks.
Browse available microtasks (each shows its fixed pay, from about €1 to tens of euros) and complete them accurately; rejected work is unpaid.

Add your payment details: PayPal (min 10 EUR/USD, not available in North America), Payoneer (min 20 EUR/USD), or SEPA bank transfer; declare self-employed/freelancer status and provide your tax number (SSN + W-9 if in the US).
Completed jobs enter the weekly bill run (Wednesday–Friday); once your payable balance meets the threshold for your method, payment is sent. Lower balances carry over to the next week.
timing: Earliest payment one week after successful completion; weekly bill runs Wednesday–Friday; balances below the method minimum carry over.
